Although powerful, its unusual shape causes it to break easily.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 30 |durability = 15 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Battle Axe}} Ancient Battle Axes are two-handed [[Weapon]]s often wielded by the [[Guardian Scout II|Guardian Scouts II]] found within [[Ancient Shrine]]s. In particular, they can be found in Shrines designated by the Trial name "A Minor Test of Strength." Scanning the {{BotW|-}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing an Ancient Battle Axe. They were forged using [[Sheikah]] [[Ancient Technology]], and while they are powerful, their unique shape makes them less durable. Since Ancient Battle Axes are made from Ancient Technology, they will deal extra damage when they are used against Guardians. They do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they cannot be manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They will, however, float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Ancient Battle Axes are part of the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons that are wielded by [[Guardian Scout]]s in Ancient Shrines.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_013" |Life = 15 |Power = 30 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon";
